installer.title: SMLIGHT Bluetooth proxy
installer.description: Use the Bluetooth of SMLIGHT SLZB gateways (SLZB-OS) as additional receiver for the Bluetooth modules
installer.name: slzb_bt_proxy

params.label: Host
params.help: Hostname or IP of the SLZB gateway, enable "Enable BLE" and "Proxy BLE advertisements" in its web interface

discovery.title: {host}
discovery.name: slzb_bt_proxy
discovery.hint: Only receives advertisements (ble_presence, ble_monitor, autodiscovery), "Enable BLE" and "Proxy BLE advertisements" must be enabled in SLZB-OS.
